birth-requires-death-condition.statement: Tudo que nasce tem condição de morte.
birth-requires-death-condition.justification: Prevents operational entities from acquiring an undefined permanent lifecycle.
birth-requires-death-condition.operationalQuestion: Qual é a condição terminal, de substituição ou de retirada desta entidade?
birth-requires-death-condition.misreadRisk: Não significa encerrar trabalho apenas pela passagem do tempo.
birth-requires-death-condition.deathCondition: Retire when every governed lifecycle contract requires an equivalent terminal or replacement condition.

creation-requires-justification.statement: Tudo que é criado é justificado.
creation-requires-justification.justification: Makes the purpose and expected value of new operational structures reviewable.
creation-requires-justification.operationalQuestion: Que problema observável justifica criar isto?
creation-requires-justification.misreadRisk: Não proíbe exploração limitada nem exige benefício já comprovado.
creation-requires-justification.deathCondition: Retire if creation rationale becomes a mechanically enforced invariant across all governed artifacts.

discovery-does-not-authorize.justification: Prevents available tools, branches, providers, or suggestions from being mistaken for permission.
discovery-does-not-authorize.operationalQuestion: Qual authority, scope e precondição realmente autorizam a ação descoberta?
discovery-does-not-authorize.misreadRisk: Não reduz o valor da descoberta; apenas separa possibilidade de permissão.
discovery-does-not-authorize.deathCondition: Retire only if every discovery surface mechanically proves and separately labels authority without semantic ambiguity.

negative-knowledge-is-knowledge.justification: Preserves validated absence, failure, and non-applicability as useful evidence.
negative-knowledge-is-knowledge.operationalQuestion: Que caminho foi descartado, com qual evidência e sob quais limites?
negative-knowledge-is-knowledge.misreadRisk: Não transforma ausência de observação em prova de inexistência.
negative-knowledge-is-knowledge.deathCondition: Retire if negative observations become first-class mandatory evidence in every relevant inspection contract.

persistence-requires-justification.justification: Prevents obsolete operational structures from surviving only through inertia.
persistence-requires-justification.operationalQuestion: A justificativa original ainda é observável e superior ao custo de manutenção?
persistence-requires-justification.misreadRisk: Não autoriza remoção sem ownership, evidência, reversibilidade e contrato aplicável.
persistence-requires-justification.deathCondition: Retire when retention and retirement evidence are mechanically required for all covered structures.

proposal-does-not-authorize.justification: Keeps heuristic recommendations and plans separate from deterministic eligibility and mutation authority.
proposal-does-not-authorize.operationalQuestion: Que validação e writer canônico transformariam esta proposta em ação elegível?
proposal-does-not-authorize.misreadRisk: Não desvaloriza planos ou recomendações; eles continuam necessários antes da aplicação.
proposal-does-not-authorize.deathCondition: Retire if every proposal artifact is mechanically incapable of being confused with mutation authorization.

readback-proves-change.statement: Sem readback, mudança não está comprovada.
readback-proves-change.justification: Requires independent observation of the intended state after an acknowledged mutation.
readback-proves-change.operationalQuestion: Qual estado foi reobservado e como ele se vincula ao plano aplicado?
readback-proves-change.misreadRisk: Não afirma que todo readback prova correção semântica; prova apenas o estado observado contratado.
readback-proves-change.deathCondition: Retire if all mutable writers make verified readback structurally inseparable from successful completion.

residue-needs-owner-and-destination.statement: Todo resíduo tem owner e destino.
residue-needs-owner-and-destination.justification: Prevents aliases, branches, compatibility paths, and migration remnants from becoming ownerless permanent infrastructure.
residue-needs-owner-and-destination.operationalQuestion: Quem decide o destino deste resíduo e qual evento o arquiva, converge ou remove?
residue-needs-owner-and-destination.misreadRisk: Não autoriza apagar resíduos sem preservar evidência e observar o writer apropriado.
residue-needs-owner-and-destination.deathCondition: Retire when every residual structure is mechanically bound to owner, disposition, and terminal condition.
